title: Extract tidy-tree layout into separate package
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR extracts the tidy-tree layout algorithm into a standalone package

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Describe the way your implementation works or what design decisions you made if applicable.

author: darshanr0107

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: Why not export the types directly?
comments.label_reasoning: The reviewer is questioning a design/API decision about not directly exporting types, suggesting the current approach is unclear or suboptimal in terms of API design.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Phrased as a question but implies a suggestion to export types directly instead of the current approach.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: It's good to keep comments that are useful
comments.label_reasoning: The reviewer is pointing out that useful comments were removed and should be kept, which relates to removal of meaningful documentation/comments.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Implies that comments were removed and should be retained — a concrete change to restore useful comments.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.label_reasoning: The suggestion refactors type declarations to derive them directly from LayoutData, reducing redundancy and keeping types in sync with their source.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Provides an explicit code suggestion to export types differently.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
blocker: This is incorrect, we should not be referencing external packages like this from this file. 

the way elk is used is also incorrect. These cannot be part of the default layout loaders, they must be registered separately.
comments.label_reasoning: The reviewer identifies that external packages are incorrectly referenced and that layout loaders are incorrectly included as defaults rather than registered separately — the code behavior does not match the intended architectural design.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Marked as a blocker and explicitly states the code is incorrect, requesting changes to how external packages are referenced and how elk/layout loaders are registered.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
bundling this with mermaid defeats the purpose of splitting it into different packages. 

The implementors will have to add them separately during mermaid init.
comments.label_reasoning: Bundling the tidy-tree layout with the main mermaid package defeats the purpose of extracting it into a separate package, indicating a module boundary/architecture violation.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags that bundling the package with mermaid defeats the purpose of the split, implying the dependency should be removed and implementors should register it separately.
